items.quote: Amazing mobile grooming services! Great at what they do. My pup loves getting her puppy spa day. Reasonable prices and best part they come to you! I highly recommend Las Tres Ye Mobile Pet Grooming.
I've been with Las Tres Ye for about 10 years and they have always been accommodating to my schedule. Walter has always done a wonderful job. Now they do dentals and once again, Walter delivered.
Amazing results, great customer service and takes his time when working with the puppy. She's never come back hurt or bleeding, overall amazing.
We've been using this company for several years and highly recommend. My puppy always comes back looking and smelling amazing. Danny takes his time and is super caring.
